title: Every bidder and result
question: What happened to each bidder in the comparison?
finding: The complete 420-row file retains winning firms, unmatched names and absent teams.
how: Each row corresponds to one entry in the agency bid extract. Rank alone was never used to identify the winner. Bid figures are the amounts transcribed on each sheet, which may be adjusted for preferences or include alternates.
limits: Bid figures across agencies are not directly comparable. An unmatched bidder could still supply a lower-tier contractor; City team data and pre-award schedules have different reporting scopes.
